payload.statement: Keep human-readable engineering statements precise and concise while preserving identity, normative force, negation, scope, quantifiers, conditions, exceptions, dependency order, and scenario roles. Derive compact agent context and exact execution instructions from the same accepted meaning and rendering/provenance machinery. Ordinary conceptual reading, inspection of plan-bound instructions, and authorized execution remain distinct operations: reading requires no invented mutation approval, an internally consistent or historical artifact is not thereby current, and inspection or delivery does not authorize execution. Do not maintain competing specifications that require manual synchronization.
payload.title: Express one meaning for humans and agents
